result:
Done. Auditory frequency tuning analysis is complete using DANDI:000986 (mouse auditory cortex Neuropixels + 5-frequency pure-tone passive listening, McCormick lab).

**Key result:** 119/235 single units in one session were significantly frequency-modulated (one-way ANOVA p<0.01), with best frequencies spanning 2–32 kHz (peaking at 8 kHz). The BF-aligned mean tuning curve shows the canonical V-shape: response drops to ~50% of BF within one octave on either side.

**Deliverables in `auditory-01/`:**
- `auditory_frequency_tuning.py` — end-to-end jupytext analysis script
- `auditory_frequency_tuning.ipynb` — Jupyter notebook version
- `fig01`–`fig06` (PNG) — raster, population PSTH by frequency, example tuning curves, summary plots, tonotopic heatmap, BF-aligned mean tuning
- `tuning_summary.csv` — per-unit baseline, ANOVA p, BF, FSI, per-frequency rates
- `README.md` — dataset, pipeline, key findings
